lines.text: Many learners say: She is more tall than me.
Better: She is taller than me.
Tall is a short word. We say taller.
Taller! He is taller than me.

data.wrong: She is more tall than me.
data.why: Tall is a short word. We say taller.

native.tip: En français, on dit « plus grande ». En anglais, avec un mot court comme “tall”, on ajoute “-er”.

en.tip: French says “plus grande”. In English, a short word like “tall” takes “-er”.
